name: Kappu
appearance: A stout, semiaquatic rodent large enough to ride, with a thick furry tail that helps it swim and balance.

Traits.name: Keen Hearing
Traits.effectNote: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on hearing.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.effectNote: One target takes 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage on a hit.

notes: The original prints Perception +2 and passive Perception 10.
In the night travel encounter, a DC 14 Wisdom (Animal Handling) check can tame grazing kappu for riding. See p. 7.
The kappu refuse to cross the 5-ft.-wide Redroar River rope bridge in the p. 8 encounter. The Companions' mounts are too large to cross safely there.
Hit Point Press, The Heart of Dako, p. 24, and reference cards, p. 8.

name: Swarm of Tanglewasps
appearance: A swarm of tiny iridescent wasps with blue-green thoraxes and dark reddish abdomens. They cluster around a concealed hardened mud nest.

Traits.name: Swarm
Traits.effectNote: The swarm can share spaces with other creatures and move through a gap large enough for one Tiny insect. It cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.

Traits.name: Wrong Step
Traits.effectNote: The swarm surrounds a 1-ft. ball of hardened mud in a 5-ft. space. Spotting the concealed nest takes a DC 17 Wisdom (Perception) check. A creature that steps on the nest is grappled on a failed save (escape DC 14). The nest can grapple only one creature. While grappled, the creature takes 5 (2d4) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. Another creature within reach of the nest can spend an action to free it with a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check.

Actions.name: Sting
Actions.effectNote: One target in the swarm's space (0-ft. reach) takes 10 (4d4) poison damage on a hit, or 5 (2d4) when the swarm is at half HP or fewer.

notes: The stat block prints a single 30-ft. speed. The reference art depicts winged insects.
The night travel table on p. 7 calls for a DC 17 group Wisdom (Perception) check to avoid disturbing nests and provoking 2d6 swarms.
Hit Point Press, The Heart of Dako, p. 25, and reference cards, p. 10.
